# VC-HB-2900

Manufacturer: G&G.
Article: 681-302-1504.
Type: chain tensioner for 10B-2 duplex, 15 teeth.
Adjustment range: 36 mm to 57 mm.
Fastener: M12. A mounting kit is included.

G&G publishes no housing drawing for this article.
There is no STEP file in this folder.
The placed solid is an envelope.
The disc uses the 15-tooth tip diameter.
The 57 mm block is the catalogue maximum of the adjustment range.
It is not a measured housing.
The envelope sits above the front stiffener, clear of the idler sprocket.
It does not mesh the chain.
